original_prompt: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: Ansible playbook (YAML)

Task: Write an Ansible playbook deploying a Java application as a systemd service: installs OpenJDK 21, creates a service user, copies the application JAR, writes the systemd unit file, and starts the service. Idempotent across re-runs.

Output only the Ansible playbook (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
- name: Deploy Java application as systemd service
  hosts: all
  become: yes
  vars:
    app_user: javaapp
    app_group: javaapp
    app_jar_source: /path/to/application.jar
    app_jar_dest: /opt/javaapp/application.jar
    app_service_name: javaapp
    java_version: 21
    java_package: "openjdk-{{ java_version }}-jdk"

  tasks:
    - name: Update apt cache
      apt:
        update_cache: yes
        cache_valid_time: 3600
      when: ansible_os_family == "Debian"

    - name: Install OpenJDK 21
      package:
        name: "{{ java_package }}"
        state: present

    - name: Create application group
      group:
        name: "{{ app_group }}"
        state: present
        system: yes

    - name: Create application user
      user:
        name: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        system: yes
        create_home: no
        shell: /usr/sbin/nologin
        state: present

    - name: Create application directory
      file:
        path: "{{ app_jar_dest | dirname }}"
        state: directory
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0755'

    - name: Copy application JAR
      copy:
        src: "{{ app_jar_source }}"
        dest: "{{ app_jar_dest }}"
        owner: "{{ app_user }}"
        group: "{{ app_group }}"
        mode: '0644'
        force: yes

    - name: Write systemd unit file
      template:
        src: javaapp.service.j2
        dest: "/etc/systemd/system/{{ app_service_name }}.service"
        owner: root
        group: root
        mode: '0644'
      notify: reload systemd

    - name: Enable and start service
      systemd:
        name: "{{ app_service_name }}"
        enabled: yes
        state: started
        daemon_reload: yes

  handlers:
    - name: reload systemd
      systemd:
        daemon_reload: yes
